Tiles from https://data.ferritefw.dev, saved 2026-11-12, for `tests/unit/ferriteData.test.ts`.

- `tafl-BP91.json`: contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada. Source: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada, Spectrum Management System authorization data extract.
- `airports-GD.json`: airport data from OurAirports (ourairports.com), public domain.
- `repeaters-FJ.json`: repeater data from HearHam.com (user-contributed).
